summary: At the recorded base, AnthropicMessagesRequest silently discarded bootstrap_host, bootstrap_port, and bootstrap_room and the converted ChatCompletionRequest contained None. At the exact candidate commit, request validation retained the fields and AnthropicServing forwarded them unchanged. The same was true for the two related DP-routing fields added by the candidate. Independent scalar, list, zero-value, omitted-field, and invalid-type parity cases passed, and the existing OpenAI serving implementation forwards the converted values into GenerateReqInput. This is a source fix with regression coverage, not test-only hardening.

tests.what_was_measured: The prepared source paths under /job/repo were imported. All five supplied routing keys were absent after AnthropicMessagesRequest validation; conversion produced None for the three bootstrap and two DP-routing fields.
The exact candidate source under /job/repo retained and converted bootstrap_host='prefill.local', bootstrap_port=9100, bootstrap_room=123456789, routed_dp_rank=3, and disagg_prefill_dp_rank=2.
Candidate regression suite: 3 passed and 61 deselected, covering scalar forwarding, list-valued bootstrap fields, and omitted fields.
Complete Anthropic serving unit suite: 64 passed and 5 subtests passed.

Independent cases preserved reported scalar values, zero values, list values including a null port, all routing fields, and omitted defaults. Fractional/object room values, a nonnumeric port, integer host, and list-valued scalar rank were rejected with the same validation categories as ChatCompletionRequest.

The candidate's committed raw pytest evidence has trailing whitespace on one progress-bar line in each of two files. Changed Python source and tests had no reported whitespace defect. This does not alter the functional recommendation, but the candidate PR prose claiming git diff --check passed is not reproducible on the committed tree.

gpu_execution.evidence: No GPU execution was necessary for the request-schema/conversion defect. The assigned environment exposes one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950-class) through torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015, but it cannot reproduce the reported Ascend 910 two-worker PD deployment.

remaining_limitations: The original Ascend 910 hardware, CANN stack, ascend transfer backend, and two-worker prefill/decode deployment were unavailable, so distributed KV-transfer execution was not reproduced end to end.

No model weights or full serving process were needed or used. Verification reaches ChatCompletionRequest and confirms the existing next-stage GenerateReqInput forwarding in source; it does not claim model semantics, Ascend behavior, or multi-node operation.
The candidate changes only Python source and tests, so no native library changed and no native rebuild was applicable.
The candidate's two committed pytest log artifacts contain trailing whitespace despite its PR body claiming git diff --check passed.
